g.text: Nine fixed-work intervals · accuracy counts accepted requests and coverage starts from original NoPF misses

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #43556b

g.text: First use is classified as a timely hit or late demand merge. A dash indicates zero denominator.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #43556b

g.text: Timely and inclusive coverage use matched dynamic operands. Net coverage divides the aggregate decrease in demand LLC misses by NoPF misses.
